thread:
Priya: handing off now, running incident for elevated API latency in us-west. root alert opened earlier: INC-20260314-1. primary for this shift was Sam, I'm taking over as primary in 5. quick summary: 95th p50->95 spike on /v1/generate, some customers seeing timeouts, partial 502s. we've been routing some traffic to model-fallback; fallback is in effect for high-latency requests.
Sam: confirming. oncall-rotation posted pager at 02:11Z, incident-bot created INC-20260314-1 and a Zoom. Mitigations in flight: pin to model-legacy, enable prefix cache for repeated prompts. latency reduced slightly but still above SLO for medium seq.
Priya: current primary/secondary? Sam was primary earlier. I'm taking the remainder of the shift as primary; Morgan you said you'd be secondary?
Morgan: yep I'm secondary until 10:30Z. I can stay on until 11Z if needed, but have a calendar conflict after that.
Javier: I can cover after Morgan if needed, available 11Z-16Z.
Priya: great. coverage plan: Priya (primary) 02:30Z-06:30Z, Morgan (secondary) until 11Z, Javier (secondary backup) from 11Z. Nikhil will be SRE escalation if control-plane issues show up.
incident-bot: [02:12Z] INC-20260314-1 created by pagerduty. severity: P1. impacted services: hosted-api (us-west), model-routing. CC: oncall-sre, prod-eng.
Priya: short mitigation checklist I'm following (from runbook): https://redwood.internal/runbooks/latency - steps 1-5 done. Next steps: verify autoscaler health and eviction logs, check kernel-level GPU / oom, review model kernel selection.
Sam: looked at autoscaler earlier — nodes in pool us-west-gpu-01 hit 100% allocation then started queueing. I increased burst capacity by 4 GPUs (manual) at 02:18Z which dropped queue depth but did not fully restore p95.
Priya: logs show repeated "kv-cache-miss" spikes for longer sequences. suspect a regression in kernel selection roll at 00:50Z. Does anyone have the rollout id?
Morgan: rollout id 2026-03-14-00:47:22-quant-opt. Took place on a subset (50%) of traffic. I'll revert that subset to canary-offline profile to validate.
Priya: go ahead with the partial revert. note: revert to model-legacy for critical customers as temporary fallback (we've already enabled model-fallback routing).
Javier: started the revert now (command pasted):
```
redwoodctl rollout revert --id=2026-03-14-00:47:22-quant-opt --percent=25 --region=us-west
```
Javier: revert at 02:36Z. watching metrics.
incident-bot: [02:37Z] rollout revert started by Javier.
Priya: after revert p95 dropped from 840ms -> 380ms in 6 minutes, errors down 70%. still a few customers seeing intermittent 502s (primarily customers with long prompt chains).
Sam: filed follow-up ticket for model rollout validation: RH-9123. Assigned to eng-ml.
Nikhil: noted in infra that some nodes show kernel OOM logs around 00:51Z — might be unrelated but adding to noise. I'll open infra ticket INF-3344 to correlate dmesg and container restarts.
Priya: good. for customer impact, product-ops please coordinate. Nikhil, can you dump the node metrics and pod crashloop logs to the incident doc?
Nikhil: copying outputs to the incident doc now: https://redwood.incidents/INC-20260314-1/logs

Priya: handoff checklist items I will complete before I leave: 1) ensure revert is stable for 45m 2) confirm autoscaler scaling policy adjusted (done) 3) postmortem ticket created with owner and timeline 4) schedule retrospective.
Morgan: I'll monitor for the next 45m and then escalate to Javier if any regressions show up. Also will add runbook note: prefer canary width 10% for quant-opt next time.
Sam: FYI there were two high-priority customers (acct-A, acct-B) that hit 5xxs. product-ops alerted their CSMs. We should include remediation commit in the exec summary.
Priya: creating postmortem ticket now: JIRA-4571 (title: INC-20260314-1 - p95 latency regression during quant-opt rollout). Owner: Sam. Due: 3 business days.
Priya: scheduling a 30m retro tomorrow 15:00Z — invites to eng-ml, eng-runtime, infra, product-ops.
Javier: action items I'm taking: 1) run model-replay on affected traffic 2) gather kernel selection deltas 3) prepare a smaller canary with additional telemetry.
Sam: action items: 1) own JIRA-4571 and include timeline + revert rationale 2) coordinate with vendor for quant kernels 3) add automated canary check in CI to detect kv-cache-miss regressions.
Morgan: action items: 1) update runbook with canary guidance 2) follow up INF-3344 with kernel logs 3) monitor customer-facing errors and update incident doc.
Priya: I'm signing off in 18m. current state: mitigations holding, p95 ~350ms, error rate ~0.4% (target <0.2%). escalation path: page Nikhil for infra, page Sam for eng-ml.
onurgent: please post any follow-up notes in the incident doc and link to tickets RH-9123, INF-3344, JIRA-4571.
Priya: handing off to Morgan now as I step out for short break — Morgan is primary for the next 45m.
Morgan: acknowledged. watching dashboards. ping me if you see any customer escalations. :thumbsup:
Priya: thanks all, leaving the thread open for updates.
incident-bot: [03:12Z] INC-20260314-1 status changed to monitoring by Priya.
Sam: I'll add a short runbook PR after dinner.
Javier: I'll paste the kernel diff and model-replay results in the doc in ~30m.
Morgan: will file a small follow-up ticket for the runbook change: RH-9130.
Priya: last note — please include a short customer-facing timeline in the postmortem so support can share with impacted accounts.
Nikhil: noted. I'll attach node-level artifacts to INF-3344 and link from JIRA-4571.
Priya: thanks team, closing my active watch. Morgan you're primary now.
Morgan: taking over.
